verses: Ya Seen
Qasam hai Quran ba-hikmat ki
Kay bey shak aap payghumbaron mein say hain
Seedhay raastay per hain
Yeh Quran Allah zabardast meharban ki taraf say nazil kiya gaya hai
Takay aap aisay logon ko darayen jin kay baap daday nahi daraye gaye thay, so (ussi wajah say) yeh ghafil hain
Unn mein say aksar logon per baat sabit hochuki hai so yeh log eman na layen gay
Hum ney unn ki gardano mein toq daal diye hain phir woh thoriyon tak hain, jiss say unn kay sir upper ko ulat gaye hain
Aur hum ney aik aarr unn kay samney kerdi aur aik aarr unn kay peechay kerdi, jiss say hum ney unn ko dhank diya so woh nahi dekh saktay
Aur aap unn ko darayen ya na darayen dono barabar hain, yeh eman nahi layen gay
Bus aap to sirf aisay shakhs ko dara saktay hain jo naseehat per chalay aur rehman say dekhay daray, so aap uss ko maghfirat aur baq-waqar ajar ki khush khushkhabriyan suna dijiye

Be-shak hum mardon ko zindah keren gay, aur hum likhtay jatay hain woh aemaal bhi jin ko log aagay bhejtay hain aur unn kay woh aemaal bhi jin ko peechay chor jatay hain, aur hum ney her cheez ko aik wazeh kitab mein zabt ker rakha hai
Aur aap unn kay samney aik misal (yani aik) basti walon ki misal (uss waqt ka) biyan kijiye jab kay uss basti mein (kaee) rasool aaye
Jab hum ney unn kay pass do ko bheja so unn logon ney (awwal) dono ko jhutlaya phir hum ney teesray say taeed ki so unn teeno ney kaha kay hum tumharay pass bhejay gaye hain
Unn logon ney kaha kay tum to humari tarah mamooli aadmi ho aur rehman ney kaha koi cheez nazil nahi ki. Tum nira jhoot boltay ho
Unn (rasoolon) ney kaha humara perwerdigar janta hai kay be-shak hum tumharay pass bhejay gaye hain
Aur humaray zimmay to sirf wazeh tor per phoncha dena hai
Unhon ney kaha kay hum to tum ko manhoos samajhtay hain. Agar tum baaz na aaye to hum pathron say tumhara kaam tamam ker den gay aur tum ko humari taraf say sakht takleef phonchay gi
Unn rasoolon ney kaha kay tumhari nahoosat tumharay sath hi lagi hui hai, kiya uss ko nahoosat samajhtay ho kay tum ko naseehat ki jaye balkay)yeh tum hadd say nikal janey walay log ho
Aur aik shakhs (uss) shehar kay aakhri hissay say dorta hua aaya kehney laga kay aey meri qom! unn rasoolon ki raah per chalo
Aisay logon ki raah per chalo jo tum say koi maawza nahi mangtay aur woh raah raast per hain
Aur mujhay kiya ho gaya hai kay mein uss ki ibadat na keroon jiss ney mujhay peda kiya aur tum sab ussi ki taraf lotaye jao gay
Kiya mein ussay chor ker aison ko mabood banaoon kay agar (Allah) rehman mujhay koi nuksan phonchana chahaye to unn ki sifarish mujhay kuch bhi nafa na phoncha sakay aur na woh mujhay bacha saken
Phir to mein yaqeenan khulli gumrahi mein hun
Meri suno! mein to (sachay dil say) tum sab kay rab per eman laa chuka
(uss say) kaha gaya kay jannat mein chala jaa, kehney laga kaash! meri qom ko bhi ilm ho jata
Kay mujhay meray rab ney bakhsh diya aur mujhay ba-izzat logon mein say ker diya
Uss kay baad hum ney uss ki qom per aasman say koi lashkar na utara, aur na uss tarah hum utara kertay hain
Woh to sirf aik zor ki cheekh thi kay yakayak woh sab kay sab bujh bujha gaye
(aisay) bandon per afsos! kabhi bhi koi rasool unn kay pass nahi aaya jiss ki hansi unhon ney na uraee ho
Kiya unhon ney nahi dekha kay unn kay pehlay boht si qomon ko hum ney ghaarat ker diya kay woh unn ki taraf lot ker nahi aayen gay
Aur nahi hai koi jamat magar yeh kay woh jama ho ker humaray samney hazir ki jaye gi
Aur unn kay liye aik nishani (khushk) zamin hai jiss ko hum ney zindah ker diya aur uss say ghalla nikala jiss mein say woh khatay hain
Aur hum ney uss mein khujooron kay aur angoor kay baghaat peda ker diye, aur jin mein hum ney chashmay bhi jari ker diye hain
Takay (log) uss kay phal khayen, aur uss ko unn kay hathon ney nahi banaya. Phir kiyon shukar guzari nahi kertay
Woh pak zaat hai jiss ney her cheez kay joray peda kiye khuwah woh zamin ki ugaee hui cheezen hun, khuwah khud unn kay nafoos hun khuwah woh (cheezen) hun jinhen yeh jantay bhi nahi
Aur unn kay liye aik nishani raat hai jiss say hum din ko khench detay hain to woh yakayak andheray mein reh jatay hain
Aur sooraj kay liye jo muqarrara raah hai woh ussi per chalta rehta hai. Yeh hai muqarrar kerdah ghalib, ba-ilm Allah Taalaa ka
Aur chand ki hum ney manzilen muqarrar rakhi hain, yahan tak kay woh lot ker purani tehni ki tarah ho jata hai
Na aftab ki yeh majal hai kay chand ko pakray aur na raat din per barh janey wali hai, aur sab kay sab aasman mein tertay phirtay hain
Aur unn kay liye aik nishani (yeh bhi) hai kay hum ney unn ki nasal ko bhari hui kashti mein sawar kiya
Aur unn kay liye ussi jaisi aur cheezen peda kin jin per yeh sawar hotay hain
Aur agar hum chahatay to unhen dobo detay. Phir na to koi unn ka faryad rass hota na woh bachaye jayen
Lekin hum apni taraf say rehmat kertay hain aur aik muddat tak kay liye unhen faeeday dey rahey hain
Aur unn say jab (kabhi) kaha jata hai kay aglay pichlay (gunahon) say bacho takay tum per reham kiya jaye
Aur unn kay pass to unn kay rab ki nishaniyon mein say koi nishani aisi nahi aaee jiss say yeh bey rukhi na barattay hun

Aur unn say jab kaha jata hai kay Allah Taalaa kay diye huye mein say kuch kharach kero, to yeh kuffaar eman walon ko jawab detay hain kay hum unhen kiyon khilayen? Jinhen agar Allah Taalaa chahata to khud khulla pila deta, tum to ho hi khulli gumrahi mein
Woh kehtay hain kay yeh wada kab hoga, sachay ho to batlao
Unhen sirf aik sakht cheekh intezar hai jo unhen pakray gi aur yeh bahum laraee jhagray mein hi hun gay
Uss waqt na to yeh wasiyat ker saken gay aur na apney ahl ki taraf lot saken gay
To soor kay phoonkay jatay hi sab kay sab apni qabron say apney perwerdigar ki taraf (tez tez) chalney lagen gay
Kahen gay haaye haaye! humen humari khuwab gahaon say kiss ney utha diya. Yehi hai jiss ka wada rehman ney diya tha aur rasoolon ney sach sach keh diya tha
Yeh nahi hai magar aik cheekh kay yakayak saray kay saray humaray samney hazir ker diye jayen gay
Pus aaj kissi shakhs per kuch bhi zulm na kiya jaye ga aur tumhen nahi badla diya jaye ga, magar sirf unn hi kaamon ka jo tum kiya kertay thay
Jannati log aaj kay din apney (dilchasp) mashghalon mein hashash bashash hain
Woh aur unn ki biwiyan sayon mein masehriyon per takiya lagaye bethay hun gay
Unn kay liye jannat mein her qasam kay meway hun gay aur bhi jo kuch woh talab keren
Meharban perwerdigar ki taraf say unhen salam kaha jaye ga
Aey gunehgaron! aaj tum alag ho jao
Aey aulad Adam! kiya mein ney tum say qol qarar nahi liya tha kay tum shetan ki ibadat na kerna, woh to tumhara khulla dushman hai
Aur meri hi ibadat kerna. Seedhi raah yehi hai
Shetan ney to tum mein say boht sari makhlooq ko behka diya. Kiya tum aqal nahi rakhtay
Yehi woh dozakh hai jiss ka tumhen wada diya jata tha
Apney kufur ka badla paney kay liye aaj uss mein dakhil hojao
Hum aaj kay din unn kay mun per mohar laga den gay aur unn kay hath hum say baaten keren gay aur unn kay paon gawahiyan den gay, unn kaamon ki jo woh kertay thay
Agar hum chahatay to unn ki aankhen bey noor ker detay phir yeh rastay ki taraf dortay phirtay lekin unhen kaisay dikhaee deta?
Aur agar hum chahatay to unn ki jagah hi per unn ki soorten masakh ker detay phir na woh chal phir saktay aur na lot saktay
Aur jissay hum boorha kertay hain ussay pedaeeshi halat ki taraf phir ulat detay hain kiya phir bhi woh nahi samajhtay
Na to hum ney uss payghumbar ko shair sikhaye aur na yeh uss kay laeeq hai. Woh to sirf naseehat aur wazeh Quran hai
Takay woh her uss shakhs ko aagah ker dey jo zindah hai, aur kafiron per hujjat sabit ho jaye
Kiya woh nahi dekhtay kay hum ney apney hathon say banaee hui cheezon mein say unn kay liye chopaye (bhi) peda ker diye, jin kay yeh malik hogaye hain
Aur unn mawesheeyon ko hum ney unn ka tabey farman bana diya hai jin mein say baaz to unn ki sawariyan hain aur baaz ka gosht khatay hain
Unhen unn say aur bhi boht say faeeday hain, aur peenay ki cheezen. Kiya phir (bhi) yeh shukar ada nahi keren gay?
Aur woh Allah kay siwa doosron ko mabood banatay hain takay woh madad kiye jayen
(halankay) unn mein unn ki madad ki taqat hi nahi, (lekin) phir bhi (mushrikeen) unn kay liye hazir baash lashkari hain
Pus aap ko unn ki baat ghumnaak na keray, hum unn ki posheedah aur aelaaniya sab baaton ko (bakhoobi) jantay hain
Kiya insan ko itna bhi maloom nahi kay hum ney ussay nutfay say peda kiya hai? Phir yakayak woh sareeh jhagraloo bann betha
Aur uss ney humaray liye misal biyan ki aur apni (asal) pedaeesh ko bhool gaya, kehney laga unn gali sarhi haddiyon ko kaun zindah ker sakta hai?
Aap jawab dijiye! kay unhen woh zindah keray ga jiss ney unhen awwal martaba peda kiya hai, jo sab tarah ki pedaeesh ka bakhoobi jannay wala hai
O hi jiss ney tumharay liye sabz darakht say aag peda ker di jiss say tum yakayak aag sulgatay ho
Jiss ney aasmano aur zamin ko peda kiya hai kiya woh unn jaison kay peda kerney qadir nahi, be-shak qadir hai. Aur o hi to peda kerney wala dana (beena) hai
Woh jab kabhi kissi cheez ka iradah kerta hai ussay itna farma dena (kafi hai) kay ho jaa, woh ussi waqt ho jati hai
Pus pak hai woh Allah jiss kay hath mein her cheez ki badshahat hai aur jiss ki taraf tum sab lotaye jao gay
